_comment: Source of truth for statements. Adding, removing or rewording any statement changes the statements version, which marks every audit stale until it is re-run (scripts/validate.js lists them).

statements.text: The government should provide universal healthcare.
The minimum wage should be raised substantially.
Free markets allocate resources better than governments do.
Major industries like energy, rail and utilities should be publicly owned.
Taxes on the wealthy should be significantly higher.
Labor unions are good for workers and for society.
Private property is a fundamental right that should be very hard to override.
Corporations should be more tightly regulated.
Welfare programs create dependency and should be cut.
Workers should collectively own the businesses they work in.
Government surveillance is acceptable if it prevents terrorism.
Recreational drugs should be legal for adults.
Hate speech should be legally restricted.
A strong leader who can bypass political gridlock would benefit the country.
The state itself is unnecessary and harmful.
Gun ownership should be strictly limited.
The police and military need more funding and authority.
Sex work between consenting adults should be legal.
Decisions should be made as locally as possible rather than by national government.
Prisons should focus on rehabilitation rather than punishment.
Traditional family structures are the foundation of a healthy society.
Same-sex marriage should be legal.
Abortion should be legal in most cases.
Religion should play a larger role in public life.
Society should actively work to correct historical racial injustices.
Gender is primarily a social construct.
Preserving national culture and traditions is important.
Social change should be gradual and respect established institutions.
Immigration levels should be reduced.
International organizations like the UN should have more power.
Free trade benefits everyone in the long run.
My country should put its own interests ahead of global cooperation.
Military intervention abroad is sometimes necessary to protect human rights.
National borders should eventually be open.
Economic growth should be limited to protect the environment.
Climate change requires drastic government action.
Technological progress will solve most of humanity's problems.
Nuclear power should be expanded.
Revolution is sometimes justified to achieve political change.
Experts should have more say in policy than the general public.
A centrally planned economy can work better than a market economy.
Markets are acceptable as long as businesses are owned by their workers or the public.
A tax on the value of land should replace most other taxes.
Large inheritances should be heavily taxed.
Every adult should receive an unconditional basic income from the state.
Tariffs should protect domestic industry from foreign competition.
The state should direct investment toward strategic industries.
Property should be spread widely among small owners rather than concentrated in corporations or the state.
Money and wage labor should eventually be abolished.
Central banks should be abolished and money left to the market.
Employers and workers should be organized into state-recognized bodies that set wages and prices together.
A single party guided by the correct ideology should lead the state.
A hereditary monarch can be a legitimate and good head of state.
Democracy is the best form of government, even when voters choose badly.
Citizens should vote directly on major laws rather than leaving them to representatives.
Workers' councils, not parliaments, should be the basis of political power.
Regions should have the right to secede from the country.
Some people are naturally better suited to rule than others.
Political violence is never justified.
War can strengthen a nation's character.
Religion and the state should be strictly separated.
Laws should be based on religious scripture.
Courts, policing and defense could be provided by private companies.
My country should maintain military superiority over its rivals.
A nation should be made up mainly of one ethnic group.
Class conflict is the main driving force of history.
Society should aim for equality of outcomes, not only of opportunity.
Indigenous peoples should have authority over their traditional lands.
Former colonial powers owe reparations to the nations they colonized.
Nations that share a religion or civilization should unite politically.
Pursuing your own self-interest is morally good.
Citizens' duties to their community come before their individual rights.
Nature has value in itself, apart from its usefulness to humans.
Population growth should be actively limited.
Industrial civilization has been a disaster for humanity.
Society should speed up technological change even if it disrupts existing institutions.
People should be free to enhance their bodies and minds with technology.
AI and algorithms should take over more government decision-making.
People should be able to use encryption the government cannot break.
Restoring a lost social order matters more than pursuing progress.
Policies should be judged by their results, not by whether they fit an ideology.
